top_signals.title: First-Time Homebuyers Find American Dream in Midwest
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Paulina Cachero joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." The American Dream of owning a home is alive, at least in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Almost half of all new homeowners in Kent County are younger than 35, as the area is a high concentration of affordable homes and plentiful job opportunities. (Source: Bloomberg)
